Initial release of the how-to-harness skill — a strict framework to guide the design of Harness-style closed-loop/self-optimizing/agent systems.

- Introduces principles HP-1~HP-7 as mandatory design checkpoints for all systems in scope.
- Defines a precise, multi-stage conversational workflow (context capture, Layer 0 validation, Socratic questioning, stepwise approval, and deliverable assembly).
- Enforces decision-making discipline: only one new dimension per round, always with explicit A/B/C/D options and justification.
- Adds consistency checks after every user decision and explicit lock-in reviews every 3 rounds.
- Strictly forbids skipping required checks, giving full solutions in one turn, or making naming/format decisions without explicit user input.

Initial release of multi-lang-coder — a polyglot code converter and language architect skill.

- Accurately flags ambiguities and conversion assumptions; never omits or mishandles critical logic.

items.summary: Intercepts and logs AI agent HTTP/HTTPS traffic, detecting secret leaks, sensitive file reads, and command injection in both directions automatically.

latestVersion.changelog:
ClawSec Monitor v1.0.0 initial release:

- Transparent HTTP/HTTPS proxy for intercepting, inspecting, and logging all AI agent traffic.
- Automatic detection of secrets leakage, sensitive file access, and command injection both inbound and outbound.
- Per-process proxy configuration and local CA for optional HTTPS interception.
- Easy install with a single Python dependency (`cryptography`).
- Threats and activity logged to `/tmp/clawsec/threats.jsonl` with deduplication.
- Docker support and 28-test regression suite included.

**Summary: Adds required AI-Mode integration and CLI version checks for robust skill invocation and compliance.**

- Introduced mandatory AI-Mode enable/disable steps for every command invocation, ensuring AI-mode is always explicitly toggled on at start and off at every exit point.
- Enforced required User-Agent header (`AlibabaCloud-Agent-Skills/alibabacloud-resourcecenter-search`) on every CLI command.
- Increased minimum supported Aliyun CLI version to 3.3.3 and clarified installation/update procedures.
- Added requirement to always run `aliyun plugin update` to ensure plugins are current.
- Documented stricter command pre-check flow and enhanced security guidance.
- No impact to resource query or scenario logic; all core search and inventory features remain unchanged.
